chapters.content:
Reminders of Him is a contemporary work by Colleen Hoover (2022).

After serving five years in prison for a tragic mistake, Kenna Rowan returns to the town where it all went wrong to reunite with her daughter.

Categorized under: Romance, Contemporary, Drama.
